page.overview:
Who is Hudson's Family?

Hudson's Family from Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Hudson from What We Found, the third story of Fazbear Frights 8: Gumdrop Angel.

Hudson (full name unknown) was the son of Steven and unnamed mother. He is the employee of Fazbear's Fright: The Horror Attraction and the main protagonist of What We Found. After going through his stepfather's abuse, he still has memories of his painful past which later causes himself to suffer from severed psyche, causing him to experience visual hallucinations in the horror attraction.

Steven was the biological father of Hudson from his childhood. Hudson remembers great memories of his father, and was described to be very fun and attentive. When he played with his son, he is always up for throwing the ball, playing a game, or just roughhousing. However, he struggled with mental illness for many years. When his small business failed and risked his family's livelihood, he committed suicide.

After Steven's death, Hudson's mother was remarried to Lewis.
